def standardize_dish_names(value):
    # Remove underscores, dashes, spaces, and special characters except hyphens and apostrophes
    value = re.sub(r'[_-]+|[^a-zA-Z0-9-\']+', ' ', value)

    # Capitalize the first letter of each word and join words with a space
    words = value.split()
    standardized_words = [word.capitalize() for word in words]
    standardized_name = ' '.join(standardized_words)

    return standardized_name

# Apply the function to each dish name and count the frequency of each unique dish name
dish_names = ['__potatoes,_sautees_or_stewed__', 'alter-sherry', 'tortue-verte-au-marsala', '--hot-sliced-turkey-sandwich-mornay,-in-potato-bordure,-with-fresh-asparagus--',
             '__(beef)_tamale__', '__REUBEN\'S_SPECIAL_TURKEY,_ROAST_VIRGINIA_HAM,_SWISS_CHEESE,_COLE_SLAW,_RUSSIAN_DRESSING__',
             '__BRANDY_PEACHES_PRESERVES__', 'borscht_koop', '__roast_spring_lamb,_mint_sauce_(ready)__', 'cold_ferris_ham',
             'BROILED-PORK-CHOPS,-APPLE-SAUCE,-VEGETABLE,-POTATO', '--hot-corn-meal-mush-and-milk--', 'brandy_(domestic)',
             'stuffed-turkey,-cranberry-sauce', 'cold-ferris-ham', '(BEEF)_TAMALE', '__fricandeau_veal_and_olives__',
             '--bread-and-butter-white?--', '__LADY_CAKES__', '--COLD-FERRIS-HAM--', '__FRICANDEAU_VEAL_AND_OLIVES__']

unique_dish_names = set()
dish_counts = {}
for name in dish_names:
    standardized_name = standardize_dish_names(name)
    unique_dish_names.add(standardized_name)
    if standardized_name not in dish_counts:
        dish_counts[standardized_name] = 1
    else:
        dish_counts[standardized_name] += 1

# Sort the dishes by their frequency and get the top 5
sorted_dish_counts = sorted(dish_counts.items(), key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)[:5]

for dish, count in sorted_dish_counts:
    print(f'{dish}: {count}')
return value
